name: realesrgan
description: Real-ESRGAN AI image upscaler with ncnn Vulkan acceleration for high-quality 2x-4x image enhancement on GPU

realesrgan.description: AI-powered image upscaler using Real-ESRGAN neural network with Vulkan GPU acceleration for 2x-4x enhancement
realesrgan.usage:
realesrgan -i input.jpg -o output.png -s 4  # 4x upscale with default model
realesrgan -i input.jpg -o output.png -n realesrgan-x4plus-anime  # anime-optimized model
realesrgan -i input.jpg -o output.png -s 2 -n realesr-animevideov3  # 2x with video model
realesrgan -i folder/ -o out_folder/ -s 4  # batch process folder
